This kit uses a separate test volume. Your console volume is preserved. It checks numerical computation, saved-state recovery, Pixel160 TIFF, and actual GPU arithmetic when WebGPU is available.

Run validation first. It reloads once automatically to check saved data.

After completion, close the browser or console application completely. Reopen this same address and select Check after browser restart. Download the resulting JSON and share it in this chat.

A missing GPU or failed check is recorded explicitly. Passing numerical checks alone does not confirm hardware GPU execution. The restart check depends on your confirming a complete application restart.
